name: Logs Explorer (Loki/Graylog style)
objective:
Replace the raw application-log viewer `client/src/components/LogViewer.vue` with a scalable, Loki/Graylog-style Log Explorer.

WHY: the current viewer downloads the whole log file as a string[] (`GET /api/system/logs/{name}?log_size=N` via `client/src/store/logs.js` + `client/src/api/modules/logs.js`) and renders every line with `v-html`, so with thousands of lines the tab freezes, search can only see what is already in the DOM, and there are no levels, facets, time ranges, pagination or context.

FROZEN API CONTRACT — `/api/logs/explorer/*` (both backend and frontend steps must honour it exactly):
- `GET /sources` -> `{ sources: [{ id, name, path, size_bytes, mtime, kind, entries_estimate }] }`
- `GET /query?source&q&start&end&level&page&page_size&order&histogram_buckets` ->
  `{ entries: [{ id, timestamp, ts_ms, level, logger, module, line, message, fields, continuation_lines, source, raw_preview }], total, page, page_size, has_more, histogram: [{ ts_ms, total, by_level }], facets: { level: [{value,count}], logger: [{value,count}], module: [{value,count}] }, stats: { scanned_lines, scanned_bytes, matched, duration_ms, truncated } }`
- `GET /entry/{id}?source=` -> full entry (raw text + parsed fields)
- `GET /context/{id}?source=&before=10&after=10` -> `{ entries: [...] }`
- `GET /tail?source=&since_cursor=` -> `{ cursor, entries: [...] }` (poll based)

QUERY LANGUAGE (AND-joined terms): `free text` (case-insensitive substring), `"exact phrase"`, `level=error,warn`, `logger~"regex"`, `field=value`, `field~"regex"`, and negation with a leading `-`.

EXISTING BACKEND FACTS:
- `api/codx/junior/log_parser.py` already has `parse_logs(log_stream)` handling `[timestamp] LEVEL [module:line] content`, continuation lines, and `request_extractor` / `profiler_extractor`. Reuse and generalise it rather than writing a parallel parser.
- Routers live in `api/codx/junior/api/*.py` and are registered in `api/codx/junior/app.py` (locate the `include_router` block; `main.py` is only 19 lines and does not register routers).
- `api/codx/junior/api/logs.py` (AI request/response logs) and `api/codx/junior/model/logs.py` are a SEPARATE feature — do not modify or break them.
- `api/codx/junior/ai/raw_log_reader.py` shows the house style for reading log files with filters and synthetic ids; follow similar conventions (docstrings, logging, Pydantic models).

EXISTING FRONTEND FACTS:
- The Logs app is `log-viewer` in `client/src/config/apps.js:278`; the component registry is `client/src/config/appMap`/`appComponentsMap.js` in `client/src/config/`.
- The AI log UI in `client/src/components/logs/*` (LogsAnalyzerDashboard, LogsTable, LogsFilterBar, LogsLiveMetrics, LogsAnalytics, LogEntryDetail) is a DIFFERENT, working feature — reuse its visual language but do not change its behaviour.
- API modules live in `client/src/api/modules/*.js` and are merged into `API`; the logs module is `client/src/api/modules/logs.js`.
- UI stack: Vue 3 + Options API mixed with `<script setup>`, Tailwind + daisyUI, FontAwesome icons.

HARD REQUIREMENTS:
- Never render log content with `v-html`. Use text interpolation plus safe span-based highlighting.
- Virtualize the result list: only the visible window (plus overscan) in the DOM.
- All filtering/pagination/aggregation is server-side; the browser never receives a whole log file.
- Keep `/api/system/logs` endpoints working for compatibility.
- No regressions in the AI logs dashboard.

steps.title: Backend: log parser + query language with unit tests
steps.objective:
Build the pure-logic core of a new application-log explorer in the `api` project (repo root `/home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/codx-junior-platform`, python package at `api/codx/junior/`). No FastAPI in this step — this is testable library code only.

CREATE package `api/codx/junior/logs/` with:

1. `models.py` — Pydantic models:
   - `LogEntry(id: str, timestamp: str, ts_ms: Optional[int], level: str, logger: str, module: Optional[str], line: Optional[int], message: str, fields: dict, continuation_lines: int, source: str, raw: str)`
   - `LogLevel` normalisation helper: map `CRITICAL/FATAL->critical`, `ERROR/EXCEPTION->error`, `WARNING/WARN->warn`, `INFO->info`, `DEBUG->debug`, `TRACE->trace`, anything else/empty -> `unknown`. Expose `LEVEL_ORDER`.

2. `parsers.py` — a generalised, streaming-friendly parser. REUSE the logic of the existing `api/codx/junior/log_parser.py` (`parse_logs`, `request_extractor`, `profiler_extractor`) instead of duplicating it; keep that module's public functions working (other code may import them).
   Required behaviour of `parse_lines(lines: Iterable[str], source: str, start_index: int = 0) -> List[LogEntry]`:
   - Primary format: `[2026-01-02 10:11:12,345] INFO [logger.name:42] message goes here` (timestamp may be `2026-01-02 10:11:12` with or without `,mmm`; logger may be `pkg.module` or empty).
   - Continuation lines (no bracket header, leading whitespace or a traceback) attach to the previous entry, are appended to `message` with `\n`, and increment `continuation_lines`.
   - Lines with NO header and no previous entry still become an entry with `level='unknown'`, `logger=''`.
   - `Request https://host/path - 12.3 ms ... "POST /path HTTP/1.1" 200` -> attach `fields['request'] = {url, method, status_code, time_taken}`.
   - `Profiler: {json}` -> attach `fields['profiler'] = {...}` when the JSON parses.
   - A line that is entirely JSON (`{...}`) and contains `level`/`message`/`msg`/`timestamp` keys -> parse it into the structured fields (uvicorn/json-logger style).
   - `ts_ms` parsed from the timestamp when possible (UTC-naive ok), else `None`.
   - `id` must be stable and unique per (source, line index): `<source>#<n>`.
   - Memory: never build the full file in memory beyond the yielded entries; do not use `readlines()` on huge files in the service step.

3. `query.py` — a small Loki/Graylog-style query language compiled to a predicate.
   `compile_query(q: str) -> LogQuery` where `LogQuery.matches(entry) -> bool` and `LogQuery.is_empty`.
   Grammar (terms are AND-joined, whitespace separated, quoted strings allowed):
   - `error` -> case-insensitive substring on `raw`
   - `"exact phrase"` -> case-insensitive substring on `raw`
   - `level=error` or `level=error,warn` -> level set membership
   - `logger~"chat_.*"` -> case-insensitive regex against `logger`
   - `field=value` -> exact match on `fields[field]` or on the named top-level attribute (`module`, `line`, `source`, `message`)
   - `field~"regex"` -> regex match on the same targets
   - a leading `-` negates any term (`-level=debug`, `-timeout`)
   - Invalid regexes must not raise: log/ignore the term and treat it as a literal substring.
   The query text must be echoed back in the compiled object so the UI can show the parsed terms.

4. Tests in `api/tests/logs/` (`__init__.py` + `test_log_parsers.py` + `test_log_query.py`), pytest style matching the existing `api/tests/*` conventions.
   Cover: header parsing with/without millis, multi-line traceback attachment, json lines, request/profiler extraction, level normalisation, unique stable ids, all query operators incl. negation, comma level lists, invalid regex fallback.

ACCEPTANCE: `cd api && python -m pytest tests/logs -q` passes. No changes to `api/codx/junior/api/logs.py`, `api/codx/junior/model/logs.py` or `api/codx/junior/ai/raw_log_reader.py`. Report the exact pytest command output.

steps.title: Frontend: explorer API client, state composable, query bar, level facets, histogram
steps.objective:
Build the frontend foundation of a Grafana-Explore / Graylog-style application-log explorer in the `client` project (root `/home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/codx-junior-platform/client`). Vue 3 + Tailwind + daisyUI + FontAwesome.

The backend is DONE and tested (99 passing pytest tests): `api/codx/junior/api/log_explorer.py` + `api/codx/junior/logs/{sources,service,parsers,query,models}.py`, mounted by the dynamic router discovery in `api/codx/junior/app.py` at prefix `/api/logs/explorer`. Read `api/codx/junior/api/log_explorer.py` first for the exact Pydantic response models. Contract, `/api/logs/explorer/*`:
- `GET /sources` -> `{ sources: [{ id, name, path, size_bytes, mtime, kind, entries_estimate }] }` (`id` is the file name, used as the `source` param)
- `GET /query?source&q&start&end&level&page&page_size&order&histogram_buckets` -> `{ entries, total, page, page_size, has_more, histogram: [{ ts_ms, total, by_level }], facets: { level: [{value,count}], logger: [{value,count}], module: [{value,count}] }, stats: { scanned_lines, scanned_bytes, matched, duration_ms, truncated } }`. Entries: `{ id, timestamp, ts_ms, level, logger, module, line, message, fields, continuation_lines, source, raw_preview }`. `source` and `level` are repeatable params; `order` is `desc` | `asc`; `page_size` is capped at 1000.
- `GET /entry/{id}?source=` -> entry + `raw`; `GET /context/{id}?source=&before=&after=` -> `{ entries: [...] }`; `GET /tail?source=&since_cursor=` -> `{ cursor, entries: [...] }`.
Query language: `free text`, `"exact phrase"`, `level=error,warn`, `logger~"regex"`, `field=value`, `field~"regex"`, negation with a leading `-`.

DELIVER:

1. `client/src/api/modules/logs.js` — add an `explorer` namespace to the existing `logsModule` (`sources()`, `query(params)`, `entry(id, source)`, `context(id, params)`, `tail(params)`). Follow the existing `_buildLogsQS` helper style; build `source` and `level` as repeated params (arrays). Do NOT change the existing `read`, `list`, `system`, `ai` members.

2. `client/src/composables/useLogExplorer.js` — a `ref`-based composable owning all explorer state: `sources`, `selectedSources`, `query`, `levels`, `timeRange` (`{start, end, preset}`), `entries`, `total`, `hasMore`, `page`, `pageSize`, `histogram`, `facets`, `stats`, `loading`, `error`, `liveTail`, `cursor`. Actions: `loadSources`, `runQuery({ reset })`, `nextPage`, `prevPage`, `toggleLevel`, `setTimeRange`, `zoomToBucket(ts, bucketMs)`, `startLiveTail`, `stopLiveTail` (setInterval polling `/tail` every 2s and appending new entries, clearing on unmount), `fetchEntry`, `fetchContext`. Debounce free-text edits ~300ms. Ignore stale responses (request sequence number) so fast typing cannot show out-of-order results.

3. `client/src/components/logs/explorer/LogExplorerToolbar.vue` — source multi-select, time-range presets (5m / 15m / 1h / 6h / 24h / 7d / custom start-end), order toggle (newest/oldest), refresh button, live-tail toggle with a pulsing "Live" badge, and a compact stats line (`matched`, `scanned_lines`, `duration_ms`, plus a `truncated` warning).

4. `client/src/components/logs/explorer/LogQueryBar.vue` — monospace query input with a placeholder showing the grammar, `Run` button, clear button, a help popover listing the operators, and clickable parsed-term chips. `Enter` runs the query; `/` focuses the input.

5. `client/src/components/logs/explorer/LogLevelFacets.vue` — clickable level chips with counts (critical/error/warn/info/debug/trace/unknown), colour-coded, multi-select, plus collapsed `logger`/`module` facet counts that emit `filter` events adding a term to the query.

6. `client/src/components/logs/explorer/LogHistogram.vue` — pure-CSS/SVG stacked bar histogram of `histogram[]` by level; clicking a bar emits `zoom` with that bucket's `ts`; hover tooltip with total and per-level counts; bucket-axis time labels. No charting library — no new npm dependency.

HARD REQUIREMENTS: no `v-html` anywhere; no new dependencies; components are presentational (state in via props, intent out via emits) except the composable. Reuse the daisyUI card/badge/btn classes already used by `client/src/components/logs/LogsFilterBar.vue` and `LogsLiveMetrics.vue`. Do not touch `LogsAnalyzerDashboard.vue` or its children.

ACCEPTANCE: `cd client && npm run build` (or `npx vue-tsc --noEmit` if the project supports it) succeeds; report the new file list plus the build result and the exact prop/emit names the next step must bind to.

Finish the Log Explorer UI and wire it into the app registry, in the `client` project (root `/home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/codx-junior-platform/client`). Vue 3 + Tailwind + daisyUI.

Read them first and use their real props/emits.

DELIVER:

1. `LogVirtualList.vue` — a dependency-free virtual scroller: props `items`, `itemHeight` (or a `measure(el)`/variable-height strategy), `overscan`; renders only the visible window plus overscan with spacers above/below; emits `scroll-end` when the user nears the bottom (to load the next page); supports `scrollToIndex(i)` exposed via `defineExpose`. Must stay smooth with 10k+ rows.

2. `LogEntryRow.vue` — one log line: level badge with colour, monospace timestamp (ms precision), dimmed logger:line, message (single line, `whitespace-pre-wrap` truncated, expandable in place for multi-line entries via `continuation_lines`), a "+" affordance for `fields` (request/profiler/JSON) that expands a small key/value grid. 4. `LogExplorer.vue` — the container that wires everything together using `useLogExplorer()`: toolbar on top, query bar, level facets, histogram (clicking a bucket zooms the time range), then the virtual list; loading/empty/error states; keyboard shortcuts (`/` focus query, `j`/`k` move selection, `Enter` open detail, `Esc` close). On `scroll-end` call `nextPage()`. When `liveTail` is on, show a pinned "N new entries" button instead of auto-jumping the scroll position.

Wiring: register the new component in `client/src/config/appComponentsMap.js` for the `log-viewer` key (keep the existing `log-viewer` app id and route in `client/src/config/apps.js` untouched so deep links keep working).
